0.0.n: Refers to students who live in a dormitory.

0.1.n: Marks boarding students as the topic of the sentence.

0.2.n: Emphasizes that this is a fixed part of dormitory life, not optional.

0.3.n: An English loanword that combines with タイム to name the scheduled study period.

0.4.n: An English loanword used with スタディ as the name of an activity period.

0.5.n: Casual form of という, introducing the name スタディタイム.

0.6.n: Stands in for a thing or activity, making スタディタイムっていう into something that can be the subject.

0.7.n: Marks the named study period as what exists.

0.8.n: The て-form of ある links the existence of study time to the explanation that follows.

1.0.n: Gives the duration of studying; no extra particle is needed here.

1.1.n: Japanese does not specify whose door or whether there is one door or several here.

1.2.n: Marks ドア as the thing being opened.

1.3.n: The て-form of 開ける links opening the door with studying, implying it stays open during study.

1.4.n: しなきゃ is a casual shortening of しなければ; adding いけない expresses an obligation.

1.5.n: Introduces the preceding requirement as the reason for what follows.

2.0.n: Describes 感じ by referring to the situation or method being shown.

2.1.n: Paired with こんな, it refers to how the activity looks or is done.

2.2.n: Marks こんな感じ as the manner in which the homework was done.

2.3.n: Names the day when the speaker did the homework.

2.4.n: Adds today to other days when the speaker also did homework.

2.5.n: Names the task completed by the speaker.

2.6.n: Marks 宿題 as what the speaker did.

2.7.n: Polite past form of やる, a common verb for doing tasks.

0.lit: As for boarding students, there is always something called study time, and...
0.tip: っていうの means something called, with っていう serving as a casual version of という.

1.lit: Because for two hours, opening the door, we have to study...
1.tip: しなきゃいけない is a common conversational way to say have to do.

2.lit: In this kind of way, today too, I did homework.
2.tip: こんな感じで is a natural expression meaning like this or in this way.
